description.en: Registers a skill/technique name substitution for the given placeholder index, so the next opened message can embed a skill's name at that placeholder.
Index of the placeholder within the message text to substitute.
ID of the skill whose name to insert.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Substitute a skill's name into the next message
CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_SKILL(_index, _skill);
